dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains the raw experimental data used in our study on the use of an argon–nitrogen mixed-gas plasma to improve the performance of laser ablation inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (LA-ICPMS).

The data include experiments comparing standard argon and mixed-gas plasma conditions, focusing on signal enhancement, oxide formation, plasma performance, and the effects of different laser spot sizes. Also included are raw data from depth profiling and elemental imaging experiments using reference materials, geological samples, and spray-coated samples.

These files are provided to support the results presented in our publication in the Journal of Analytical Atomic Spectrometry (JAAS) and to make the experimental data openly available for reference and further research.
dct_title_s: An Argon-Nitrogen Mixed-gas Plasma for Rare Earth Element Imaging Applications using Laser Ablation Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry
